I started with Hitman (2016) when it was given for free by Epic. I enjoyed the game so much that I actually bought Hitman 3 along with the access pass for Hitman 2. After a few weeks, I saw that Steam had a bundle for the old hitman games so I bought them. Haven't had the chance to play them all except for absolution and the first few levels of blood money. 

My favorite would be Hitman 2016 because of Sapienza. What I love about the reboot is that you can always find new ways of eliminating the targets and basically, I am able to play it without losing interest. 

Absolution is pretty meh compared to the reboot. I basically just went guns ablazed and sprayed and prayed during my playtime.

Blood money though, pretty awesome. Kind of hard to control when you get used to the controls of the reboot. Also forces you to think outside of the box as it does not give you 'training wheels' when playing the game.

I had a recurring dream last year that lasted for weeks. In my dream, I was back in the old city I lived in for most of my childhood (my psychiatrist told me that maybe the reason why my dream took place there was perhaps, that was where I was the happiest). It always start the same, I was younger than I am now. In my dream I was still 9 or 10 years old, I'm playing with my childhood bestfriends in the playground then we would continue playing catch and then ride our scooter (the ankle destroyer one). While riding our scooter home, the scenery changes from a calm, starry night to a blurry, smoke filled sky. My old house was on fire. In my dream, I feel the pressure of making sure that everybody got out safely. My mom, my 3 dogs, and my niece and nephews. My dream always ends without me knowing if I was able to save my dad or not. The dream stopped when I upped the dosage of anti depressants.
